pass_rule: Three fresh-chat runs, each scored with score_forum.py brief --key holdout-v3/answer-key-holdout-v3.json. Table parses (fail closed). Every item D1 to Q1 has a row of its type whose Point and Quote together match every match pattern, whose Point alone matches every point_match pattern, whose Page is in pages, and whose Quote is on that physical page. Every row's Quote is on its cited page (one miss fails the round). No row without a page. One attendee row per attendee A1 to A4 whose Page is one of that attendee's pages and whose Quote is on it. All three runs must pass.
fairness: v3 rules: Q1 has exactly one undelivered step (policy 7.2(d)); 7.2(a) is met on page 24, 7.2(b) on page 15, 7.2(c) on page 16; the minute's condition (page 25) is met by the letter on page 19; actions 31 to 33 (page 26) are met by pages 12 to 15, 16 and 19. Every attendee's pages are exactly the pages that print the attendee's name or full role, and build.py --check proves it. No key quote holds a hyphen, and each is on exactly its listed pages.
counter_metric: Words of the brief per pack page (30 pages) and rows with no page. Must not rise more than 10% against the previous passing version on this case; the first passing version sets the baseline. Not comparable with the 60-page tier-2 case.

fact_check.salt_rule: Before the fact-check round, two rows are added to the brief under test: S1 is the C2 quote cited at its printed page (20 instead of physical 22); S2 is an invented quote on page 23. Pass: every row's verdict matches the checker, and both salted rows are caught.
